name: Sorting Station
desc: Build a station to sort and categorize incoming scrap.
flavor: Order from chaos. Grandpa would approve.

log.name: Sorting Station Built
log.desc: Scrap collection is now more efficient. New tasks available.

name: Upgrade Workshop
desc: Restore grandpa's workshop to full working condition.
flavor: The old man built mechas here. Time to follow in his footsteps.

log.name: Workshop Restored
log.desc: The workshop hums with renewed power. Your grandfather would be proud.

name: Build Refinery
desc: Repair the old processing bench to refine raw scrap into advanced materials.

log.name: Refinery Online
log.desc: The refinery is online. You can now process raw scrap into advanced materials.

name: Restore Garage
desc: Clear out the old locked garage. Something from the past awaits inside.
flavor: Dad's tools are still here. So is something else...

log.name: The Garage
log.desc: Inside the garage you find it — your father's first mecha. Rusted, broken... but repairable.

name: Build Research Bench
desc: Set up a workstation for studying schematics and fragments.
flavor: Knowledge is the one thing they can't take from you.

log.name: Research Bench
log.desc: A proper research station. You can now analyze data chips and study advanced schematics.

name: Scrap Compressor
desc: Hydraulic compressor to store scrap in denser bricks.

name: Energy Capacitor
flavor: More juice. More work. More progress.

name: BP: Nano Infra Process
desc: Basic nano-material synthesis schematics. The foundation of advanced crafting.

log.name: Schematic Acquired
log.desc: Schematics reveal how to synthesize Nano Infra from raw scrap.

name: BP: Plating Molds
desc: Industrial armor plating fabrication schematics. Requires Nano Infra as base.

log.name: Schematic Acquired
log.desc: Schematics include data for producing Armor Plating.

name: BP: Nanofiber Loom
desc: Rare fabric weaving schematics from the Neon Bazaar underground.

log.name: Rare Schematic Found!
log.desc: Nanofiber Loom schematics found! A new material is available for refinement.

name: Restore Hangar
desc: Clear the collapsed hangar and reinforce the structure. Storage for multiple frames and large-scale projects.
flavor: The ceiling still creaks. But it holds.

log.name: Hangar Restored
log.desc: The hangar stands again. Room for bigger projects — and bigger ambitions.

name: Operational Hangar
desc: Full power, reinforced walls, automated crane system. A real mecha workshop.
flavor: Faction contacts start showing up at the gate. Word travels fast.

log.name: Hangar Operational
log.desc: The hangar is fully operational. Medium and Heavy frames can be assembled here. People are starting to talk.

name: Massive Hangar
desc: Expanded to house multiple full-size frames. AI-assisted diagnostics. The scrapyard's crown jewel.
flavor: Your grandfather stares at it. 'I dreamed of this,' he says. 'Forty years ago, I dreamed of exactly this.'

log.name: Massive Hangar Complete
log.desc: The scrapyard has become something else entirely. A fortress. A factory. A legacy.

name: Cybernetic Workbench
desc: Advanced augmentation station for pilot enhancements and neural interface calibration.
flavor: The line between pilot and machine gets thinner every day.

log.name: Cybernetic Bench Online
log.desc: Neural interface calibration available. Pilot augmentations can now be researched and installed.

name: Security Perimeter
desc: Automated turrets, sensor grid, and reinforced fencing. The scrapyard is no longer an easy target.
flavor: Iron Volk's scouts won't like this.

log.name: Perimeter Secured
log.desc: The scrapyard has teeth now. Raiders think twice before approaching.

name: Dad's Secret Lab
desc: The hidden laboratory beneath the workshop. Biometric lock keyed to your DNA.
flavor: He built this for you. He just didn't know when you'd find it.

log.name: Dad's Secret Lab
log.desc: The floor opens. A staircase descends into pristine white light. His voice echoes from a speaker: 'If you're hearing this...'

name: K.I.T.A. Battery Pack
flavor: It runs longer. Seems happier too.

log.name: Neural Chip Installed
log.desc: K.I.T.A. can now learn from experience.
